text:
maria.t: Heads-up — embedding probes started showing spike in WS handshake failures after KV cache TTL rollover, noticed around 10:12 PST. p95 handshake latency jumped from 120ms to 1.2s. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/probe/d/E4A/embeddings
aj: Hmm, is this tied to GPU preemptions or network flaps?
maria.t: Doesn't look like GPU; node uptime fine. Logs show: `error: websocket handshake timeout: waited 15s` and `kv-cache: miss / priming` repeatedly.
ken: Sounds like probes are losing sticky session state when the probe's short-lived session TTL expires. We should try renewing sessions rather than creating new ones every probe run.
liam: Agree. Also add a Prometheus histogram for `probe_handshake_duration_seconds` and alert on p95 > 500ms for 5m.
deploy-bot: alert triggered: EMBEDDING_PROBE_HANDSHAKE_P95 (job: emb-probe-eu): 620ms at 1977654330
aj: For cost, we can do adaptive sampling: keep full-rate probes for 2 regions, sampled probes elsewhere. That saves GPU priming cost.
ken: Proposed probe config snippet:
```
probe:
  kind: ws-embedding
  sample_rate: 0.15
  session_ttl_seconds: 900
  session_renew: true
  backoff:
    base_seconds: 30
    factor: 2
```
maria.t: Nice. Can we also try short-lived KV warmups cached per-probe-run, e.g., store a 2-token prefix for 60s to avoid cold KV misses?
liam: Yep. PromQL for SLO ratio I used locally:
```
100 * (1 - sum(rate(probe_handshake_failures_total[5m])) / sum(rate(probe_requests_total[5m])))
```
ken: Action items: ken->prototype session_renew (PR ETA tomorrow), aj->update Grafana panel and add p95 alert, liam->add histogram metric + dashboard. maria.t->run 24h sampled test in eu-west1.
maria.t: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
